Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for offering to run a combined SOC2/DPA walkthrough for our compliance team. Were trying to keep these sessions during our internal quiet hours (low trading volume) to minimize interruptions for our ops team in the EU. Those are typically 13:00-15:00 CET on weekdays.

- SOC2 scope and recent controls changes
- DPA evidence mapping (data residency and access logs)
- Pen-test scheduling constraints (we only need a readout now; vendor kickoff later)

I attached a short evidence matrix but happy to expand if you need anything else.

Avail: 13:00 CET on the 13th or 15th look best for us. Please suggest concrete slots and well confirm.

Thanks,

FinAtlas

- Tue 2026-12-14 13:30-14:45 CET
